goal: Travel from Pewter City through Mt Moon and reach Cerulean City

subgoals.goal_text: Leave Pewter City and enter Route 3
Travel east across Route 3 to reach the entrance of Mt Moon
Navigate through the first floor of Mt Moon and find the stairs down
Navigate through the first basement of Mt Moon and find the stairs down
Navigate through the second basement of Mt Moon to reach the exit
Travel east across Route 4 to reach Cerulean City
